text.card: A red giant 5,601 parsecs away, 22 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 0.86 solar masses and 21.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,370 K at its surface.
